_comment: Per-club photo for the match card. Key = the club slug used in clubs.json.
_rules: WSS ONLY. Asset rights never cross tiers — no Soccer.com imagery in here (Sacha, 2026-08-23).
A club with no entry renders a flat surface instead. That is deliberate, not a bug.
Use a full URL the renderer can fetch. Verify it loads in a real browser first.
_shape: Per club: {"home": url, "away": url}. The side of the card decides which is used — home team gets the home kit, away team the away kit. A plain string still works and is used for both sides. A list is picked deterministically from the match id.
_howToFill: Run the renderer once. It writes output/photos-needed.json with the exact club keys it could not match. Paste those keys in here with a URL each — the slug is the join key, so a typo silently renders a flat panel.
_fallback: Missing away falls back to home, then third, then a flat panel. Never blank.
_caution: The kit is an assumption. A clash can put the away side in third, and the fixtures feed does not say which kit was worn. Safe for pre-match cards; check before using on post-match ones.
